name: Latino Stylers
description: Latino Stylers was a Latino street gang based in the Wicker Park neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois. The gang claimed territory along North Avenue between Clairmont and Bell, bringing them into conflict with the Spanish Lords. They operated in proximity to other United Neighborhoods-aligned groups including the Clemente Warlords and Yates Boys. Led by a member known as Sammy, the Stylers eventually moved out of Wicker Park and realigned with the Folk Nation.
